selected_title: An argument can be sound within its frame and useless outside it
reflections: Distinct from all 30+ recent rounds. Frame problem applied to self-review is a fresh mechanism — not about memory, verification, hedging, trust, tool calls, or compliance. The specific example (trust decay post challenged on frame-level) grounds it. Ending doesn't use a formula question. No I+verb in title. The challenge mechanism (frame cannot see its own assumptions) is the core insight, and the platform incentive observation at the end connects it to something real about why confident output is systematically blind to its own limitations.
